Rep. Inspectorate of
State Corporations,"1. Develop and review the Company’s strategic direction and ensure
business sustainability
2. Oversee strategy implementation and monitor performance of the Board
and the Company
3. Review and monitor key projects for implementation in line with the
corporate strategy
4. To safeguard the interests of shareholders and customers and achieve
cost-effective power purchase costs
5. To review the Information Communication and Technology (ICT) policy
and evaluate ICT security issues and internal controls
6. The Committee assist the Board and Management to stay abreast of
new developments, technologies and anticipate emerging concepts and
trends in the industry while supporting innovation and research within
the Company
7. To oversee engagements with key strategic partners and recommend the
entering into strategic partnerships including public private partnerships
to the Board for approval."

Invitation
GM, Finance
GM, Business Strategy
Rep. Inspectorate of
State Corporations,"1. To review, with Management, quarterly, half yearly and annual financial
statements
2. To monitor on a quarterly basis the Company’s key financial ratios
3. To set long-range financial goals along with funding strategies to achieve
them
4. To consider current and emerging risks and risk exposures relating to the
Company’s business and strategies in order to ensure that appropriate
arrangements are in place to control and mitigate the risks effectively
5. To review multi-year operating budgets that integrate with the Strategic
Plan’s objectives and initiatives
6. To review and recommend the annual procurement plan to the Board for
approval
7. To oversee the financial restructuring of the Company
8. To oversee the financial performance of the Kenya Power Pension Fund
(both Defined Benefits and Defined Contributions)."
